row.team_price_text: Plus: starts at $0, event-volume pricing (first 2M events/month free), unlimited seats
row.evidence: Amplitude's pricing comparison lists "Advanced permissions and SCIM" as Not included on Free, Plus and Growth and Included on Enterprise, and the SCIM API docs say "SCIM API (bulk user management) is available on the Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Changed since June: SCIM now needs Enterprise (June row said Growth); the pricing table and the SCIM API plan-availability table both mark Growth 'Not included'. Status stays gated. SAML SSO starts at Growth (Contact Sales). Plus pricing changed: the visible pricing page now says Plus 'Starts at $0' with event-volume pricing (first 2M events/month free) instead of June's $49/mo flat; the page's embedded CMS data still carries 'Starting at $49/mo' (see conflicts). Every plan has unlimited seats, so per-user fields are null. June's 'median contract $63.7K/yr' and '~$36K+/yr' figures have no first-party source and are dropped. The non-SCIM User Management API (roles, group membership, effective access) is Enterprise-only and uses Support-issued org keys.

plans.name: Plus
plans.price_text: Starts at $0, first 2M events/month free, scales with event volume

auth.token_source: Organization settings > Access and SSO Settings > Provisioning Settings > Enable SCIM Provisioning > Generate SCIM Key
auth.notes: Regenerating the SCIM key immediately invalidates the old key.

deprovision.notes: active=false removes the user from the organization and the user loses all access; for pending users the invitation is revoked. Seats are unlimited on every plan, so seat freeing does not apply.

filtering.notes: Filter must follow SCIM filter syntax; supported attributes not listed.

attributes.notes: id equals the primary email; one email per user; all core Group schema fields supported.

roles.how: SCIM Groups are Amplitude permission groups; project role assignments are not managed by SCIM and use the separate User Management API.

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per minute per organization; Amplitude can lift this for bursts on request.

limitations.text: The route says /scim/1, but '1' is Amplitude's API version; the implementation follows SCIM 2.0, not 1.1.
The Groups field on user routes is ignored; group membership is managed through Group routes.
Email (id/userName) cannot be changed through SCIM.
Created users receive an email invitation and are reported active even before accepting it.

auth.notes: HTTP Basic with Organization API key and Organization secret key issued by Amplitude Support; orgId query parameter required.

capabilities.notes: User lifecycle is SCIM-only; this API covers project role assignments, roles, group membership and effective access.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log (UI) is on all plans; the API needs Support-issued org API and secret keys; plan gate for the API is not stated. 30-day max query range, 90-day retention.

limitations.text: Organization API key and secret key must be requested from Amplitude Support; the org API key isn't available in the UI.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked (page markup); SAML is not checked. Amplitude documents SAML with Okta as a manual configuration.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SSO and JIT only; amplitude-provisioning-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: From Amplitude's SSO docs (G Suite guide).

onelogin.notes: From Amplitude's SSO docs (OneLogin guide); OneLogin's connector page not loaded.

open_questions: SCIM key expiry is not documented (only regeneration).
ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, ResourceTypes, Bulk and /Me SCIM endpoints are not documented.
Whether a SCIM-deactivated user can be reactivated by setting active=true is not documented.
Whether SCIM removal ends active sessions is not stated explicitly ('loses all access').
Which attributes can be used in SCIM filters is not listed.
Whether SCIM needs SAML SSO configured first is not stated.
The plan gate for the Audit Logs API (as opposed to the UI audit log on all plans) is not stated.
Whether Plus is billed monthly or annually, and its per-event tier prices, are not shown in the static page text.
